buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 3. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Service & Support In the event where the distance travelled exceeds the monthly usage variant, amount will be paid for additional Kms as per schedule. Similarly, the unused Kms in a particular month as against the minimum guaranteed usage variant will be carried forward to the next month and additional Km if any in the next month shall be adjusted against this. However, the payment for the selected usage variant in a month will be paid every month.” Further, the unused Kms in a particular month shall not be carried forward or adjusted beyond 6 months 6. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG

Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Sr. Divisional Fianance Manager-Bhavnagar A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) ​Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The MUV vehicle is required for the use of Senior Section Engineer (Bridge) Junagadh of Western Railway of Engineering Department of Bhavnagar Division. Office address is Senior Section Engineer (Bridge), Ju nagadh Railway Colony-Junagadh-362002, Gujarat. The MUV is required to reach up to bridge approach during inspections. Bidder should agree to run vehicle in night as per required by railways. 2. The model of vehicle so offered shall not be older more than Jan-2025. 3. The contractor have to submit 5% EPBG in form of FDR/BG of nationalized bank in favour of Sr. Divisional Fianance Manager-Bhavnagar within 15 days from issue of Gem Contract without fail to Dy. C E (Bridge) Ahmedabad office and if not submitted within time period, then no Payment of hiring of vehic le shall be made to the contractor till the submission of 5% EPBG by the contractor. 4. The service provider should be from Gujarat State only and driver should be local from Junagadh only fo r proper attention and service due to nature of job. Office of the Service Provider must be in the same st ate of consignee. 5. Assurance for trouble free service and availability of fuel all time in MUV. Bidder should not deny service during emergencies of railways. 6. No deviation in the Railways standards and specification/terms and conditions of bid shall be acceptable by Railways. 7. The Quarterly Bill cycle will be maintained by the contractor and online bills will be submitted for payme nt through GeM Portal by the contractor. 8. The driver provided for the hired vehicle by the bidder shall be having valid RTO Light Vehicle License & registered with Government Labour Department and salary details of driver shall be provided by bidder with bills. 9. As per para 19 of GeM Terms and condition 5% EPBG shall be forfeited if the contract is closed on party' s request/account and also will be de-barred for participating in GEM for 3 Months. 10. While Gem Bid Submitting, agency should keep all above aspects and in case of any deficiencies noted , Bid/contract will be disqualified/ terminated. ​
